provenance.title: God Object
provenance.method: countFunctions/functionCountFlagged from the pinned mirror over `git ls-files` at the recorded commit
provenance.metric: patterns[name === "God Object"].files — analyzed files where isCode !== false && functions.length > 15 (index.html detectPatterns `godFiles`); `functions` is the headless parser count over raw text and `isCode` gates files absent from codeExts (notably `.mts`)
provenance.filedVsPinnedNote: the issue was filed with 43 files at analyzedAt 1791804971015, but only 23 of them are flagged by the pinned analyzer at the base commit — 20 are not (5 are `.mts`, which is absent from CODE_EXTS, plus 15 that count 4-14). Repo-wide the base has 24 flagged files, so the filed list is inflated by the same skew recorded for #2004 (63 filed vs 38 measured). Acceptance is the measured drop on the delivered branch, not the filed number.
provenance.afterNote: the after measurement counts the delivered tree; the oracle, its fixture and the split test modules are `.mts`/`.json`/`.py`/`.go` test files, and only the `.py`/`.go` ones are scored — every new sibling lands <= 15, so it does not enter the flagged set.

after.note: 24 - 4: the two cited Python splits, the uncited `disk_space_test.go`, and `server.py` (reduced by #2031, see `reducedByLater`). Every still-flagged file is recorded under `deferred`.

removed.reason: the Caveman mode extension was removed with its whole tree (#2072)

reducedByLater.reason: #2031 moved server.py's `/api/repos/*` routes into `handler_api.py` (16 -> 13 functions), so the 1274-line → 8-module split that #2034 deferred did land. server.py stops flagging without a #2034 follow-up, so it moves here instead of leaving the ledger.

deferred.reason: no Rust toolchain in the pipeline image — `which cargo rustc` is empty and no workflow compiles `embedded/docker/ui`, so a move cannot be checked in-gate (#2002/#2003/#2004/#2005/#2006 precedent)
deferred.requires: rustc/cargo in the gate (rust:1.99 builder image) — no workflow compiles embedded/docker/ui

deferred.reason: `fp-filter.js` is COPYed into the Docker build and mirrored by the codeflow shim; a split changes that copy set, which the owning boundary guard must move in the same change
deferred.requires: Dockerfile COPY set + codeflow shim copy-set updated in the same change

laterReduced.reason: #2035 split the long files still over 500 segments. `ui/tests/session_controls.rs` was 708 segments and 17 functions; its AC1/AC2/AC3 journey moved into `ui/tests/session_controls/journey.rs`, which lands both halves at 15 and 2 functions, so it stops flagging without a #2034 follow-up. The other 20 deferred paths still flag, so `after.godObjectCount` and the ledger are unchanged.

notScored.reason: `.mts` is absent from CODE_EXTS at the pinned ref, so the analyzer never scores these (yet they were filed)
scored but already under the ceiling — the pinned analyzer counts 4-14 functions, so these were never flagged

tradeoffs.godObject: 24 -> 21 flagged files (-3, -12.5 %). 23 of the 43 filed paths are flagged; 20 are not (5 `.mts` + 15 under the ceiling). Of the 23, 2 land in-gate as real splits and 21 are recorded deferrals, each with the `requires` the next issue needs.
tradeoffs.scope: 19 Rust files stay deferred because `which cargo rustc` is empty and no workflow compiles `embedded/docker/ui`; a verbatim move looks safe but `#[cfg(feature = "ssr"|"hydrate")]` gating, `pub(super)` visibility and macro scope are only proven by `cargo check`, and merging unverified changes into the RPC relay is worse than a stale metric.
tradeoffs.falseNegative: `cmd/cheasee-pi/disk_space_test.go` counts 26 and is not in the filed list; it is the one flagged file both cheap and gate-verifiable (`go test ./cmd/cheasee-pi/ -count=1`), so it is reduced here and recorded as UNCITED_REDUCED rather than silently dropped.
tradeoffs.rejected: Re-pinning the analyzer to score `.mts` in this change would add 5 files and invalidate the #2004/#2005/#2006 baselines at once; the skew is recorded instead.
tradeoffs.risk: if the live analyzer scores `.mts`, the `notScored` `.mts` group (16, 19, 16, 16, 24 functions) becomes real work — verify the ref before closing, not after.
